title: Galvor Scout, in Sunil’s words: filters show size, not trust
hook: Filters show a CMO how big a creator’s audience is. They don’t show whether that audience trusts them.
caption:
Filters show a CMO how big a creator’s audience is.
They don’t show whether that audience trusts them.

In 8,673 creator checks, 62% of creators with top engagement for their size still weren’t right for the brief.

That is the gap we built Galvor Scout for. It reads the reels and the comments against a brief written in plain words, so the team spends its time on the final call, not the first shortlist.

Follow Galvor for what we keep learning from these checks.
